summary: Completed public-preview API and UI verification for the AgriSutra MVP. All 7 backend regression checks passed; farmer dashboard, selling journey, quantity recalculation, chat, roles, Hindi toggle, and mobile layout passed. The offer confirmation UI is not integrated with the offer API.

minor.issue: Store net calculation includes a packaging field in the returned store breakdown but does not subtract that packaging cost from store_net, so the transparent cost model is internally inconsistent.

integration_issues.issue: Confirming an option only sets local sent state; the frontend never POSTs to /api/offers, so no backend offer is created despite the success message.

action_items: Wire confirm-offer-button to POST /api/offers and show success only after a successful response.
Reconcile store packaging treatment between store_net and the displayed transparent cost fields.
critical_code_review_comments: Do not display a successful offer-created state before the backend offer creation request succeeds; this currently creates a false transaction state.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public preview tested at configured REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. API dashboard/analyze/offers/role/assistant all passed. Desktop end-to-end and mobile Hindi/no-overflow passed. Voice control presence was verified, but actual browser speech recognition was not available to execute.
rca of the issue: In App.js, the offer modal confirm handler is onClick={() => {setOffer({sent:true});}} and does not call axios.post(`${API}/offers`, ...). The success component is therefore purely local. In server.py, store_net subtracts storage, spoilage, transport, and commission but not the separately returned packaging amount.
